units.title: Re-measure agent runs vs 2026-07-09 baseline
units.prompt:
GOAL
Re-measure agent-run token/wall-clock statistics and compare against the recorded 2026-07-09 baseline to judge whether the workflow-context optimization held. Read-only.

Workflow guidance: none

BASELINE (2026-07-09, pre-optimization; full receipt: goals/workflow-context-optimization/notes/T001-token-latency-baseline.md)
- median unit wall-clock 14m13.5s; p90 37m38.7s (30 timed units)
- effort distribution: low 3 / medium 4 / high 21 / xhigh 4; high median 18m45s vs medium 3m47s
- retry phases = 20.7% of wall-clock; 2/17 retried units recovered
- median first model call 17,719.5 input tokens (AGENTS wrapper ~26%); post-rebuild spot measurement was 13,044
- median session: 4.7M cumulative input tokens, 44.5 model calls, 95.55% cached

TASK
Analyze the crew runs and codex sessions created AFTER 2026-07-10 (skip anything older):
1. Unit wall-clock from .fable-codex/runs/*/ledger.jsonl: median/p90/max, split by effort (from packets.json) and sandbox. Compare to baseline.
2. Verify time: the ledger now has verify_started/verify_command_finished/verify_finished events with durations - report verify share of unit wall-clock (this was unmeasurable at baseline).
3. Retries: attempt_failed counts and whether any packet opted into maxRetries>0; confirm fail-fast is holding.
4. Token stats from ~15 newest markless codex_exec sessions in ~/.codex/sessions: median first-call input, cumulative input, model calls, cached share. Compare to baseline and to the 13,044 post-rebuild first call.
5. Effort distribution of new units - did medium become the majority as policy intends?
6. Quality signals: unit failure rate vs baseline (19/32 failed then), any 'Workflow guidance' blocked returns, and re-cut frequency if inferable from run names/prompts.
7. VERDICT: for each baseline metric state improved/flat/regressed with numbers, then answer: (a) did the optimization deliver? (b) is the remaining wall-clock dominated by loop length (model calls/session)? If yes, say so explicitly - that is the trigger for the deferred coordinator-system goal.

CONSTRAINTS: read-only; sample deliberately and say what you sampled; label estimates as estimates; a metric that cannot be derived is reported as such, never guessed.
ESCALATION: return blocked with open_questions if the logs are missing or the baseline seems incomparable.

OUTPUT: markdown comparison table (baseline vs now) plus the verdict.
